Initial release of Proactive Agent Lite—adds proactive capabilities to OpenClaw agents.

- Introduces memory architecture with pre-compaction flush for better context retention.
- Implements reverse prompting to suggest unasked ideas.
- Adds self-healing patterns for automatic diagnosis and issue resolution.
- Includes security hardening with safe defaults.
- Integrates alignment systems to keep agents mission-focused.
- Lightweight and compatible with all OpenClaw agents.
